title: ObjectRigidBody2D with a center of mass: its own ODE2 Jacobian
author: Claude-JG
description: The left-hand side -m omega^2 A c of a center of mass off the node is differentiated numerically by CSystem, serially. Decided: an analytic Jacobian by phi and omega, assembled in parallel.
releaseNotes: ObjectRigidBody2D with a center of mass computes its ODE2 Jacobian analytically, in parallel with several threads.
